status: PLACEHOLDER. Not agreed by the working group. The tool must show this status wherever the strategy card appears.
purpose: Turn a subdomain profile into a provisional strategy: develop guidelines from scratch, contextualise existing ones (adopt or adapt), or build foundations first.
unknownHandling: Unknown and n/a ratings are excluded from medians and listed separately as 'evidence needed'. A group with more than half its subdomains unknown returns 'insufficient evidence' instead of a result.

rules.label: Develop from scratch for the top priorities; contextualise the rest
Contextualise first (adopt or adapt existing guidelines) while building production capacity
Adopt trusted guidelines with minimal changes; invest in foundations (Domains 1, 2 and 4)

alwaysShow: The rule that fired and the medians behind it
Blocking subdomains: any subdomain in a rule group at stage 0 or unknown
Next steps: for the three lowest-stage subdomains, the anchor text of the next stage up (or 'anchor not yet defined')
